answer_1.quote: Conversational Question Generation (CQG), which targets generating questions given the context and conversational history ...

answer_2.quote: We utilise BERTScore as our dialog entailment metric (BERTScore‑entailment) ... We also introduce Context Coverage (CC) and Conv‑Distinct ...

answer_3.quote: Following Do et al. (2022), we train a T5 model on CoQA as our CQA model to answer the generated questions. A question is passed this filtering step if the answer generated by the CQA model has a fuzzy matching score greater or equal to 0.8 with the input answer span.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation is critical to evaluate the quality of the generated conversations ... We hire three annotators who are English native speakers. Each generated question is rated by annotators on a 1‑3 scale. We follow ... to utilize three criteria: (1) Factuality, (2) Conversational Alignment, (3) Answerability.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated question on factuality, conversational alignment with history, and answerability using a 1‑3 scale.
